To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of formal object-oriented notations can provide the benefits of an engineering approach to accident modelling.
a formal object-oriented approach can be used to construct task analysis models that are scalable, modular and encapsulated and can be used in accident modelling.
a task analysis can be constructed using an object-oriented specification language, which is modular, scalable and can be used to reason about human errors in accident reports.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of a formal object-oriented notation to the analysis of accidents.
how a formal task analysis can be used in accident modelling and the advantages this brings.
developing a methodology for accident modelling that can be used in the future by the accident investigator, as a means to improve the quality of their reports.

the use of formal methods in the analysis of accident reports has shown how the quality of these reports can be improved and that a task analysis can be constructed using a formal notation, which is suitable for the representation and reasoning of human factors.
the formal object-oriented specification approach is a powerful tool for the analysis and representation of accidents and incidents.
a formal task analysis model has been developed and applied to an accident investigation report.
